title_en: Rickmers Genoa Shipping Company and Rickmers Steamship Company v. CS Shipping Co., Ltd. — dispute over compensation for damage from ship collision
ruling_gist_en: Article 208 of the Maritime Code of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Maritime Code) provides that claims for salvage remuneration are not subject to limitation of liability for maritime claims. However, when the salved party claims compensation from the colliding party by treating the salvage remuneration paid by itself to a third party as its own loss, the nature of such remuneration has been transformed into damage caused by the collision accident, and the colliding party may enjoy limitation of liability for maritime claims in respect of such remuneration.
